merge-deals.label: Merge Deals
merge-deals.description: Merges one deal into another, removing the first.

dealId.label: Deal ID To Merge Away (this deal is removed)
dealId.description: The numeric ID of the deal that will be CONSUMED and no longer exist after the merge.

mergeWithId.label: Surviving Deal ID (this deal is kept)
mergeWithId.description: The numeric ID of the deal that SURVIVES the merge and receives the other deal's data.

merge-deals.beforeRequest:
if (Number(inputs.dealId) === Number(inputs.mergeWithId)) throw new Error('A deal cannot be merged with itself.');
return request;

merge-persons.label: Merge Persons

mergeWithId.label: Surviving Person ID (this person is kept)
mergeWithId.description: The numeric ID of the person that SURVIVES the merge and will NOT be overwritten.

merge-persons.beforeRequest:
if (Number(inputs.personId) === Number(inputs.mergeWithId)) throw new Error('A person cannot be merged with themselves.');
